title: Record that a document contains this opening, which the catalogue has never said
description: Two analysed-in claims on C.RyL, the first use of a relation that has been in the closed set of docs/chronicle-layer-design.md since the design was written and had never been exercised: 'published analysis, subject is a publication event'. Every other claim in this table says a game played a line; these say a document analyses one. Proposed 2026-08-04 in docs/evidence/provenance/opening-in-print.md and blocked until now on the builder overwriting the tables. The pair is the point: the position was written down around 1490 and the name arrives in 1561, so for a catalogue whose subject is names rather than moves the gap between the two rows is the fact worth having. Lucena is deliberately absent — the sources that put the Ruy López among his eleven openings are a blog post and Grokipedia, which is below the standard applied to everything else here.
